Exact Smith computations establish six units, four 2s, five 4s and one 12. For eleven Frobenius types, the exact \([M\mid F-I]\) integral presentations produce the recorded invariant factors. The supplied source verifies both incidence equivariance for all 720 permutations of 6 Weierstrass points and the finite group computations for 11 classes. Classical node/trope labels are independently supported by Kumar §4.2. No infinite-field conclusion is inferred from finite field sampling.

originality.rationale: The exact \(16\times16\) Smith diagonal and 11 distinct Frobenius coinvariant presentations were compared against the published classical 16_6 configuration, Kummer lattice studies, relevant incidence-matrix theory, and accessible published-finding corpus records. Known geometry implies the incidence matrix and, with new computations, the answer, but inspected named statements do not present the complete arithmetic coinvariant profile or the zeta-indistinguishable pair with nonisomorphic coinvariants. Residual risk of an older equivalent design table is genuine, and priority is not independently verified.
residual_risks: Older biplane incidence or algebraic coding literature may tabulate the Smith form or coinvariants under equivalent terminology.

value.rationale: The primitive integral incidence obstruction is a natural equivariant arithmetic refinement of the geometric Kummer 16_6 configuration; it answers the complete descent question for eleven Frobenius types. A contrasting pair of forms has identical node and trope zeta functions but nonisomorphic coinvariant groups, demonstrating information not encoded by rational permutation representations. Such finite exact classifications have value independently of a downstream conjecture.
